Title: Nikhil's Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Anjali - 38 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Kavya - 8 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
4. Sharda - 67 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
4. The classroom - a blackboard, benches

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Anjali and Sharda stand near him.]

Sharda: "Let's do something fun today."

[Nikhil puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Nikhil: "And then?"

[Nikhil takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Sharda: "I'm ready!"

[Nikhil munches on an apple.]

Anjali (excited): "Well done!"

[Nikhil drinks a glass of water.]

Anjali: "Hey, look at that!"

[Nikhil gulps down a glass of milk.]

Anjali: "Exactly right."

[Nikhil sits down on a chair.]

Nikhil: "Mom, look at this."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Let's begin."

[A light drizzle begins.]

Nikhil: "Let's see."

[A storm breaks over the village.]

Nikhil (softly): "Hey, look at that!"

[Lightning flashes across the sky.]

Nikhil: "Exactly right."

[Hailstones start falling.]

Nikhil: "Oh wow!"

[Thick fog covers the village.]

Nikhil: "That's great!"

Scene 3: The bedroom - Day

Anjali: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil yawns loudly.]

Nikhil: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Nikhil stretches his arms above his head.]

Nikhil: "Really?"

Scene 4: The classroom - Day

[Nikhil stands in the classroom. Anjali and Sharda stand near him.]

Sharda: "Nikhil, look over here."

[Nikhil raises his hand to answer.]

Nikhil: "Hey, look at that!"

[Nikhil writes on the blackboard.]

Nikhil (surprised): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Nikhil reads his book at his desk.]

Sharda (softly): "I knew it!"

[Nikhil yawns in the class.]

Nikhil: "I really enjoyed today."
